what: The measured per-item cost of a composite shard's exporting phase, and the single band the #135 read trace runs against. Extracted from the retained #129 probe artifact, which is gitignored and lives on one machine; the contract validator needs a baseline that exists in the repository, and the finding should outlive the laptop.

source.method: n_items = distinct STAC items whose footprint intersects any 512-column chunk of the band; n_reads = sum over column chunks of intersecting items, x2 bands; src_px = intersected footprint area in native pixels x2

fit.over: the comparable 512-row composite bands, item count against exporting seconds

band.why: the highest distinct-item count among the comparable 512-row bands

unmeasured: The physical cause of the per-item cost. #129 excluded dependency assembly and falsified the GDAL cloud-configuration premise by dumping the effective config inside a read task, then closed with no candidate.
